name: memory-vector
description: Vector memory store using LanceDB + Ollama embeddings. Supports semantic search, indexing text/documents, and RAG-style recall. Long-term memory with similarity search.

default_subscriptions.description: Embed and store a piece of text. Payload: {text, metadata?}.
Semantic similarity search over stored vectors. Payload: {query, top_k?}.
Index a directory of text/markdown files into the vector store. Payload: {path}.
Drop and rebuild the vector store from all previously indexed sources.
